constraints.statement: Each new regression test must fail when the fail-closed assert or the executor staleness check is reverted while the rest of the change remains.

claim: Fail-closed epoch fencing is scoped to epoch-bound operations only. A strict 'no epoch on the move defers' reading regressed ~30 rebalancer suites (~250 assertions) because direct non-planner createOperation callers (initial-partition provisioning ADD, runtime-service legacy cleanup REMOVE) never carried an epoch and are not epoch plans — failing them closed would break DDL provisioning. Implemented: (A) assertMembershipPublicationEpoch defers an epoch-bound move when the current epoch is UNREADABLE (typed MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH_UNAVAILABLE skip into the rebalance loop's retry-next-cycle path); (B) new operation-workflow-dispatch-epoch-gate.js fences stale ADD/REPLACE at dispatch (readable-advanced epoch fails closed; unreadable defers DEFERRED_RETRY_PENDING) and the epoch is carried in the executor request; (C) step-history epoch write DELETED, epoch now on the operation record top-level with the dispatch gate as its genuine reader (legacy stepsHistory fallback). Red-on-revert verified for both the assert and the executor gate.
